dedupe_keys.name: samdata spesialisthelsetjenesten norwegian statistics on hospital and specialist health service activity bed places costs and productivity

description: SAMDATA is the Norwegian Directorate of Health's statistics series on the specialist health services, which in Norway means hospitals, contracted specialists and specialised mental health and addiction care. The page read on 2026-09-28 states that SAMDATA produces comparable statistics and analyses of developments and differences in these services as a basis for steering them. The statistics pages cover activity and use of services in somatic care, rehabilitation, substance abuse treatment and mental health care, shown both by patients' area of residence and by treatment site: outpatient, day and inpatient treatment, surgery, bed places at treatment sites, patients ready for discharge by municipality, and compulsory mental health care; further views give costs and productivity by sector. Coverage is Norway, by health region, hospital trust or municipality depending on the view. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the views are interactive dashboards, so export options and the years covered were not read, and the definitions follow Norwegian patient registers. It supports health service capacity studies, such as relating inpatient demand and bed places across hospital areas to plan surge capacity. Related record: the Norwegian national quality indicators from the same directorate.
name: SAMDATA spesialisthelsetjenesten: Norwegian statistics on hospital and specialist health service activity, bed places, costs and productivity
